decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD sits close to the firm's established reissue and catalog business, costs little to keep listed in a warehouse-backed shop, and has given no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search, so management has no reason to drop it.

The illustrated release series builds on the firm's core competence in carefully produced editions and fits its goal of broadening formats, so with no signs of underperformance and a multi-model line that can be adjusted rather than abandoned, it is kept.
